project: Ultra-low-power fully-analog ECG arrhythmia classifier on SKY130 with ReRAM crossbar

summary.overall_verdict: NOT PUBLISHABLE at any peer-reviewed venue in current state. Two fatal findings invalidate the core 'fully analog' claim. The 94.92% accuracy is verified only in software emulation using effective weights — the actual SPICE netlist produces identical outputs for all inputs (WTA failure). Nine major findings would each require revision at JSSC/TBCAS. After fixing fatal+major issues, the work would be competitive for BioCAS conference or TCAS-II brief.

findings.finding: Top-level SPICE netlist produces IDENTICAL outputs (all 1.788V) for ALL inputs. The WTA does not discriminate between classes. The 'full analog accuracy' of 94.92% is computed entirely in software using effective weights extracted from unit-input characterization — it is NOT the result of running the actual classifier netlist.
findings.evidence: verify_circuit_classifier.py spot-check: Beat 22597 (N): vout=[1.788 1.788 1.788 1.788 1.788]; Beat 41222 (S): same; Beat 31504 (V): same; Beat 25759 (F): same; Beat 6191 (Q): same. All 5 WTA outputs saturate near VDD.
findings.impact: The core claim — fully analog classification — is unverified. Reported 94.92% is software emulation. Actual circuit accuracy is 0%.
findings.what_a_reviewer_would_say: The actual SPICE simulation shows all WTA outputs identical at 1.788V. The 'full analog accuracy' is computed in Python, not from the circuit. Fundamental disconnect between claimed and actual performance.
findings.remediation: Debug top-level netlist: likely CCCS currents swamping WTA bias, missing I-to-V conversion, or impedance mismatch. Effort: 2-4 weeks.
findings.precedent: Papers rejected from JSSC for behavioral-vs-transistor-level discrepancies.

findings.finding: 146 ideal SPICE elements (8 VCVS + 138 CCCS) have NO transistor-level implementations. These behavioral models cannot be fabricated.
findings.evidence: top_level_classifier_circuit.spice: 8 Econd (VCVS) + 138 Fmac (CCCS). generate_top_level.py acknowledges 'ASIC: differential amplifier with resistive feedback' but no circuits exist.
findings.impact: ~40% of classifier components are ideal. Real implementation needs 8 precision diff amps + 138 current mirrors — unaccounted area, power, mismatch.
findings.what_a_reviewer_would_say: The 'fully analog' pipeline relies on 146 ideal elements. Without transistor-level implementations, the claim is misleading.
findings.remediation: Design transistor-level input conditioning and current-mode interface. Effort: 4-8 weeks.
findings.precedent: JSSC requires all signal-path elements at transistor level.

findings.finding: ReRAM devices modeled as ideal resistors (R elements), not sky130_fd_pr_reram instances. PDK model is a zero-ohm stub: 'R0 BE TE 0.000000'.
findings.evidence: L1/L2 crossbar .spice files use Rrp/Rrn plain resistors. PDK reram_cell.spice contains only a 0-ohm resistor.
findings.impact: Real ReRAM nonlinearity, read disturb, drift, and variability not captured. Novelty claim technically true but meaningless.
findings.what_a_reviewer_would_say: Crossbar uses ideal resistors, not the PDK model (which is itself a stub). Novelty claim invalid.
findings.remediation: Integrate calibrated compact model or run sensitivity analysis vs resistance variability. Effort: 1-6 weeks.
findings.precedent: Multiple papers criticized for ideal memristors without variability.

findings.finding: All simulations at tt/27C/nominal VDD only. No PVT corner analysis. Subthreshold: 30mV Vth shift changes current by ~2.2x.
findings.evidence: All testbenches '.temp 27'. No ss/ff corners. No voltage/temperature sweeps.
findings.impact: Design may fail at ss corner or elevated temperature.
findings.what_a_reviewer_would_say: No PVT corners for subthreshold circuits is a critical omission.

findings.finding: No Monte Carlo or mismatch simulation. Diff-pair sigma(dVth) ~1.6mV -> ~4% current mismatch. interstage_bias_relu.spice zeroes all mismatch params.
findings.evidence: No .mc directives. Mismatch sigma=0 in interstage.
findings.impact: 225mV feature span may not be met on worst-case mismatch.
findings.what_a_reviewer_would_say: No MC for subthreshold circuits is unacceptable.
findings.remediation: 200-point MC on key circuits. Effort: 2-3 weeks.

findings.finding: Bias generator has NO startup circuit. Two stable states: desired + zero current. .ic statements force desired state in sim.
findings.evidence: bias_gen.spice comment: 'Production ASIC would use a proper feedback startup circuit.'
findings.impact: Silicon-kill risk: system may never turn on.
findings.what_a_reviewer_would_say: No startup circuit is not acceptable for fabrication-targeted design.
findings.remediation: Add startup circuit. Effort: 1-2 days + 1 week verification.
findings.precedent: Every JSSC self-biased reference includes startup.

findings.finding: Circuit feature cache DS2 has 21 records — record '123' missing. Accuracy evaluated on incomplete test set.
findings.impact: 0.1-0.5% accuracy shift. Results not comparable to published benchmarks.
findings.what_a_reviewer_would_say: Incomplete test set. De Chazal specifies 22 records.
findings.remediation: Regenerate cache with 22 records. Effort: hours.

findings.finding: V recall is 80.4%, 10 points below 90% target. 570/3216 V beats misclassified as N.
findings.impact: Missing 1 in 5 V beats is clinically concerning.
findings.what_a_reviewer_would_say: V recall below target raises safety concerns.
findings.remediation: Class-weighted training or larger hidden layer. Effort: 1-2 weeks.

findings.finding: F recall 51%, Q recall 0%. Macro F1 = 0.61 vs weighted 0.95. N = 88.7% of test set — overall accuracy inflated by imbalance.
findings.impact: Only 6.2% above trivial classifier. F performance clinically inadequate.
findings.what_a_reviewer_would_say: Report macro F1 prominently. Overall accuracy misleading on imbalanced data.
findings.remediation: Class-weighted loss, report macro F1. Effort: days.

findings.finding: No noise analysis for any frontend circuit. At ~63pA bias, diff-pair noise is high and unquantified.
findings.impact: Features may be buried in noise if readout noise approaches 225mV span.
findings.what_a_reviewer_would_say: No noise analysis for deep-subthreshold frontend is a first-order concern.
findings.remediation: Run .noise on each diff-pair. Effort: 1-2 weeks.
findings.precedent: Standard for analog signal processing papers.

findings.finding: Frontend and classifier never simulated together. Python mediates the interface — frontend voltages captured numerically, fed as DC sources to classifier.
findings.evidence: No .spice file contains both frontend and classifier. full_accuracy_test.py and verify_circuit_classifier.py are separate flows.
findings.impact: Loading effects, settling, and supply coupling at interface uncharacterized.
findings.what_a_reviewer_would_say: End-to-end SPICE simulation essential for 'fully analog' system claim.
findings.remediation: Combined top-level netlist, simulate a few beats. Effort: 2-4 weeks.
findings.precedent: JSSC requires end-to-end for system claims.

findings.finding: Best seed (47) reported, not mean. Mean 94.39% +/- 0.31%. Analog (94.92%) > software (94.75%) is within noise but suspicious.
findings.what_a_reviewer_would_say: Report mean +/- std. Explain analog > software.

findings.finding: 2pF S&H caps with NFET switches — leakage/retention uncharacterized.
findings.evidence: W=32 L=32 MIM in qrs_slope, qrs_width, pwave_diff. No hold-time sim.
findings.impact: Likely acceptable (~5mV/s at 27C) but unverified at 85C.
findings.what_a_reviewer_would_say: Characterize S&H droop at worst-case temperature.

findings.finding: All 35 PFET mismatch params zeroed — idealized.
findings.remediation: Enable mismatch, run MC. Effort: 1 week.

findings.finding: All energy numbers hand-calculated, not simulation-measured. No .meas in any sim.
findings.evidence: GOALS.md budget table. No .meas or measured power in results.
findings.what_a_reviewer_would_say: Energy claims are estimates, not measurements.
findings.remediation: Add .meas to transient sims. Effort: 1-2 weeks.

findings.evidence: No aging sim. Conductance range 0.296-99.273 uS.

findings.finding: float32 in feature cache vs float64 in training.
No formal comparison table with matching protocols.
findings.evidence: GOALS.md mentions competitors in passing only.

findings.finding: 1,664 ReRAM cells, no yield analysis. At 99.9% yield: ~19% chip yield.
findings.impact: Manufacturing may be impractical without redundancy.
findings.remediation: Yield analysis + redundancy scheme. Effort: 1-2 weeks.

consensus_fatal: ReRAM modeled as ideal resistors, not PDK cells (4/4 reviewers)
WTA outputs all 1.788V, circuit does not classify (4/4 reviewers)
consensus_major: PFET mismatch zeroed / no Monte Carlo (4/4)

verified_clean: StandardScaler: no data leakage (fit on DS1 only, applied to DS2)
No feature uses future information (EWMA temporal causality correct)
Weight mapping verified to machine epsilon (<1e-14 reconstruction error)
De Chazal inter-patient protocol correctly implemented
All 8 frontend circuits use real SKY130 transistors (no ideal elements in frontend)
Hybrid mirror+parallel-diode load topology correctly prevents bistability
Offset-binary encoding verified: V_row(mean)=0.075V for all channels

summary.verdict: NOT PUBLISHABLE at JSSC or TBCAS in current state

overall_assessment.what_is_proven: The mathematical pipeline is sound: 8 analog features correctly mapped from SKY130 circuits, MLP weights correctly mapped to differential ReRAM conductances with <1% error, effective-weight reconstruction achieves 94.92% inter-patient accuracy. This is a valid design-space exploration, NOT a circuit demonstration.

venue_readiness.JSSC: NOT READY. 6-12 months. Needs everything plus post-layout extraction.
venue_readiness.TBCAS: NOT READY. 4-6 months. Needs working netlist, real ReRAM, PVT, Monte Carlo, energy.
venue_readiness.BioCAS_conf: POSSIBLE after fatal fixes + honest metrics. 1-2 months.
venue_readiness.arXiv: POSSIBLE NOW with simulation study framing.

critical_path: 1. Fix WTA DC operating point (2-4 weeks)
2. Replace ideal R with sky130_fd_pr_reram cells (1-2 weeks)
4. Monte Carlo with real PFET mismatch (1-2 weeks)
10. Design peripheral circuits or label as abstractions (1-8 weeks)
